join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!set displayWarnings on
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 :!filter emotes
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 access=subscriber :!filter emotes
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter emotes what
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !filter emotes on|off|max|single|status


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Filters are now enabled.


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/2 chatter-display=Random :this is a normal message
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter emotes status
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Emote filter=false, max=4, single=false


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter emotes off
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Emote filter is already disabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter emotes on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Emote filter is now enabled.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!filter emotes on
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Emote filter is already enabled.
